$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: PromptSuggestions
description:
A row of suggestion cards shown above an empty PromptArea — a
separate, small composition-only piece (not part of PromptArea
itself), since suggestions are a property of the surrounding empty
chat state, not of the composer's own value/behavior.
whenToUse: Starting points above an empty composer — what the assistant is good at, as tap-to-ask prompts.

whenNotToUse.instead: short reply chips under the last answer

anatomy.description: a short, concrete prompt each, optional icon; 2–4 of them.

do.caption: Concrete questions about the user’s own data — they show what’s possible.
do.example:
<PromptSuggestions
  aria-label="Suggestions"
  onSelect={() => {}}
  items={[
    { id: '1', label: 'Why is shop.seashell.dev slow today?' },
    { id: '2', label: 'Which certificates expire this month?' },
    { id: '3', label: 'Summarize last night’s backup' },
  ]}
/>

dont.caption: “Help”, “Ask a question”: nothing to learn, nothing to tap for.
dont.example:
<PromptSuggestions
  aria-label="Vague suggestions"
  onSelect={() => {}}
  items={[{ id: '1', label: 'Help' }, { id: '2', label: 'Ask a question' }, { id: '3', label: 'Learn more' }]}
/>

a11y: Each suggestion is a button. In onSelect, fill or send the prompt and move focus to the composer — the component doesn’t do it for you.
